cases.name: decide without a decision model: exit 4, nothing on stdout, one notice on stderr — /team-spec's closed-choice test (noul)
cases.cmd: h=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1; trap 'rm -rf "$h"' EXIT; export HOME="$h" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$h/.config"; for v in $(env | sed -nE 's/^(((ORKEON_|DOTNET_)?(Orkeon__|Llm)|TYPESAFE_API_KEY|LIQUID_API_KEY|KEV_API_KEY)[^=]*)=.*/\1/Ip'); do unset "$v"; done; command -v orkeon-bench >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf 'ok (skipped: orkeon-bench is not on the PATH)'; exit 0; }; r=$(orkeon-bench decide noul --question 'The need holds a closed choice.' 2>/dev/null; echo "exit=$?"); e=$(orkeon-bench decide noul --question 'The need holds a closed choice.' 2>&1 >/dev/null); [ "$r" = 'exit=4' ] && case "$e" in 'notice: no decision model: '*) true;; *) false;; esac && [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$e" | wc -l)" -eq 1 ] && printf 'ok' || { printf 'MISMATCH %s / %s' "$r" "$e"; exit 1; }

cases.name: decide with a remote provider and no --allow-remote is no model either: exit 4, nothing on stdout, orkeon never started
cases.cmd: h=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1; trap 'rm -rf "$h"' EXIT; export HOME="$h" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$h/.config"; for v in $(env | sed -nE 's/^(((ORKEON_|DOTNET_)?(Orkeon__|Llm)|TYPESAFE_API_KEY|LIQUID_API_KEY|KEV_API_KEY)[^=]*)=.*/\1/Ip'); do case "$v" in TYPESAFE_API_KEY) continue ;; esac; unset "$v"; done; command -v orkeon-bench >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf 'ok (skipped: orkeon-bench is not on the PATH)'; exit 0; }; r=$(orkeon-bench decide noul --question x 2>/dev/null; echo "exit=$?"); e=$(orkeon-bench decide noul --question x 2>&1 >/dev/null); [ "$r" = 'exit=4' ] && case "$e" in 'notice: no decision model: '*) true;; *) false;; esac && [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$e" | wc -l)" -eq 1 ] && printf 'ok' || { printf 'MISMATCH %s / %s' "$r" "$e"; exit 1; }

cases.name: decide with a decision provider that does not answer: exit 5, nothing on stdout (the skills then take their path without a model)
cases.cmd: h=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1; trap 'rm -rf "$h"' EXIT; export HOME="$h" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$h/.config"; for v in $(env | sed -nE 's/^(((ORKEON_|DOTNET_)?(Orkeon__|Llm)|TYPESAFE_API_KEY|LIQUID_API_KEY|KEV_API_KEY)[^=]*)=.*/\1/Ip'); do case "$v" in ORKEON_Orkeon__Decision__Provider|ORKEON_Orkeon__Kev__BaseUrl|ORKEON_Orkeon__Kev__MaxRetries) continue ;; esac; unset "$v"; done; command -v orkeon-bench >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf 'ok (skipped: orkeon-bench is not on the PATH)'; exit 0; }; command -v orkeon >/dev/null 2>&1 || { printf 'ok (skipped: orkeon is not on the PATH)'; exit 0; }; r=$(orkeon-bench decide noul --question x 2>/dev/null; echo "exit=$?"); [ "$r" = 'exit=5' ] && printf 'ok' || { printf 'MISMATCH %s' "$r"; exit 1; }

cases.name: /team-run keeps its path without a model: decide score is a second signal, exit 4 changes nothing
cases.cmd: f={{CLAUDE}}/skills/team-run/SKILL.md; grep -q 'orkeon-bench decide' "$f" && grep -q "Exit 4 (no decision model) or any other code: no flag, no retry" "$f" && printf 'ok' || { printf 'MISMATCH: %s lost its path without a model' "$f"; exit 1; }

cases.name: /team-spec keeps its path without a model: the closed-choice test stays Claude's, the user decides
